summary: BioCardia filed an 8-K (Items 8.01 and 9.01) disclosing a press release announcing completion of its clinical consultation process with Japan's PMDA regarding application materials for regulatory approval of its CardiAMP Cell Therapy System for ischemic heart failure. No transaction, ownership change, or capital event is described; no price, stake, premium, or advisor is named. The item is furnished, not filed, under Exchange Act Section 18. Mechanics center on an anticipated Japanese marketing approval submission, the US analog being an FDA pre-submission/NDA-type milestone. What to watch: timing and outcome of the Japanese marketing application and any financing needs.
